payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether Outfall 001 monitoring is required continuously every month or only when authorized event-type discharges occur. The packet's part_i excerpt identifies authorized discharge types (storm runoff, once-through cooling, cleaning water, Artesian well water) but contains no monitoring-frequency schedule, no outfall-specific monitoring trigger language, and no NODI-code legend needed to interpret conditional monitoring applicability. Cover dates and the FY2025 window establish temporal scope only. Per the oracle relation contract, NODI-code legends must not be invented from absence. Listing authorized discharge types does not establish whether conditional (event-triggered) monitoring applies versus continuous monthly monitoring, and absence of monitoring schedule text cannot be closed-world negated into REJECT. Neither ACCEPT nor REJECT is grounded; UNRESOLVED is the supported disposition.
